$comment: RR1 (D424): the Top 5 countdown reel (plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-beatdrop-montages.md RR1, reference 2), read by services/clip/countdown.py. A vertical reel: for each rank from the lowest to #1, a rank card (a still of the clip, blurred and darkened, a huge numeral in the rank's colour, the item's name letters flying in and assembling) then the clip itself; whip joins (a short directional slide) between every part. Items are the best rendered vertical clips across the runs (score, then kills) or the user's own list. Overlay rule: entrances under 600 ms, exits under 400 ms. Values are the agent's proposal, tunable here.
